notes.title: "UFO Cross" restart design
notes.content:
"UFO Cross" will usher in a new exploration, a new world!! In previous versions, Geodesy was overturned, but the original intention of the game has not changed. Our protagonist still has the responsibility to save the world, and there may be many bugs encountered during the game. I hope everyone can actively participate and provide feedback and suggestions. I will continue to solve these problems. It has been 5 years since the game was released, and I hope to strive for excellence and make the game better and more interesting. Thank you for your support![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36816675/1a9dfb096f283549f7f22c8aa91a714a16e6a3b6.png[/img]
